ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_000
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
『那个，网上传了一段小阿拉蕾和夜子老师
在吵架的视频』

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_001
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
『虽然觉得难以置信，
但想着还是应该跟你说一声……』

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_002
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 小阿拉蕾，不用勉强自己装开心啦

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_003
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 有种和大家一起唱歌的感觉，很棒呢

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_004
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 说起来，夏季剧场版里的那个新角色！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_005
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 班上的同学们也在那边

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_006
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: Raki好像两个版本都喜欢呢～

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_007
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 没想到你还挺活泼的呢

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_009
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 快看快看～是《魔法露露》的水杯哦～

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_011
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 该不会你还没注意到吧？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_015
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
让泥久等啦～
啊，是你朋友吗？
